title: 再听一遍 · Listen Again
description: 三条留言，一次还没等到的见面。阿登听着熟悉的声音，手里的手机越来越紧。

sources.title: Super Supportive — Sleyca
sources.note: User-supplied EPUB, FIVE: The Nice One, three saved voicemails through Alden switching off the System. Mandarin adaptation, not official translation.

planning.sourceBoundary: Three saved voicemails; stop before Outside the window, buildings raced past.
planning.dramaticChange: Hannah’s cheerful promise gives way to Cly’s proposed funeral; Alden stops playback without resolving her fate.
choicesAndCallbacks: Voice or smile: distinct private attention, rejoin first recording.
Visit or ice park: preserve annual promise, rejoin Cly.
Any day or still away: contrast assurance and absence, rejoin latest message.
Birthday or mother: attend to different costs, rejoin teleport invitation.
planning.voiceReason: Recorded affection and Alden’s private bodily response carry this quiet source passage.
planning.desire: Hear Hannah’s familiar voice and hold on to her promised return.
planning.obstacle: The messages move from a short postponement to six months missing.
planning.earlyCare: He can picture her smile with his eyes shut and wonders whether her brightness is for him.
planning.payoff: Reveal exactly what the three messages contain; Alden makes the small concrete decision to stop replay.
planning.newUncertainty: Will Hannah return, and will Alden accept a teleport to the proposed funeral?
planning.directing: Alden remains seated on the train; recorded speech is quoted within his first-person hearing, never staged as live speakers. Listener framing holds the six-month revelation and next reader-controlled bodily response.

signatures.Alden: Quiet sensory attention; seated, increasingly downcast, tight grip described honestly.
signatures.Hannah: Bright direct greeting, practical reassurance and specific future plan in a recording.
signatures.Cly: Initial fluent reassurance gives way to hesitations and careful qualifications.

teaser.speaker: Hannah
teaser.line: We’ll hang out when I get back.
teaser.scene: Hannah leaving the cheerful voicemail before her summons; the promise Alden replays on the train.
teaser.style: Luminous cut-paper collage with layered paper shadows
teaser.finishing: Use clean final 2.9 seconds of generated shot after extra early speech; retain three-second first-frame hold.

planning.pinyinReview: Reviewed all 43 entries and contextual chunks. Corrected sustained zhe, necessity dei, complement/adverbial de, lexical neutral syllables, reduplicated verbs and experience guo; retained full-tone renwu. Reviewed hai, zhi, date and summon readings.
limitations: Recorded voices are quoted within Alden’s first-person narration; speaker portraits remain offstage to avoid presenting a live conversation. Phone grip is conveyed through text; seated posture and expression carry the visual aftermath.

continuation.end: Alden replays Hannah’s summons message and Cly’s two updates. Hannah has been missing six months; her friends propose a funeral on her birthday. Alden switches off the System without answering the teleport invitation. Her death is not confirmed.
continuation.nextStart: Outside the window, buildings raced past.
continuation.nextEndBefore: Suddenly, a flip-flop nudged Alden’s shin.
continuation.note: City repairs and Skiff’s pursuit lead Alden to remember Hannah’s changing heroic motto and consider why superheroes need support. Preserve his inferences as inferences.
continuity: Alden is sixteen on the train with Jeremy and Boe.
Hannah left on her fourth summons six months ago and has not returned.
Cly proposes a funeral on February thirteenth, Hannah’s birthday, and offers to order Alden a teleport.
Alden has not accepted the invitation. Hannah’s death remains unconfirmed.
Alden stops the System after replaying all three messages.

contains: “她要是还不回来，我们就要为她准备葬礼。”
“现在已经半年了。我们……跟她一起的那些人，觉得不能一直这样等了。”
他跟我说一切都好。可是，这一次说话的人不是她。
